checks.title: CP1 active source and evidence equivalence
checks.summary: Checked-in CP1 overlay and shared sources reproduce accepted physical-pin HDL. Saved simulations are reused with pinned inputs, models, fixtures and logs.

checks.title: CP1 native connectivity parity
checks.summary: All 12 sheets match native KiCad connectivity; 230 backplane net groups match HDL interfaces.

checks.title: CP1 physical package allocation
checks.summary: 192 DIP logic/memory packages; 96 fewer than the 288-package baseline. All footprint pads are through-hole.

checks.title: CP1 structural electrical checks
checks.summary: No unresolved structural findings in 12 sheets; pin and footprint checks passed.

checks.title: Exact parts and sourcing
checks.summary: Owned HCT191/245/574 manufacturer/suffix/counts and remaining sourcing decisions are open.

checks.title: Independent ALU image contract
checks.summary: All 2,097,152 ALU words independently checked.

checks.title: CP1 instruction contract
checks.summary: 227 opcodes / 454 cases / 23,002 cycles at each of three delay profiles; 24 continuous CPU profiles and ROM boot passed.

checks.title: CP1 compiled demo execution
checks.summary: ROM boot reaches HALT in 2,840,175 microcycles with exact text and zero errors across 48,000 pixels; no host bootstrap injection.

checks.title: CP1 memory decode and pin routes
checks.summary: 131,073 reads, 48,897 SRAM writes, 16,384 protected ROM writes and 256 IO writes; mixed-delay checks passed.

checks.title: CP1 register capture and release
checks.summary: 2,052 captures, 4,096 transfers and four resets per profile; enable and initialization-clock faults detected.

checks.title: CP1 physical ALU paths
checks.summary: 8,192 vectors, 256 flag loads and 64 C/Z commands; mixed-delay checks passed.

checks.title: CP1 sampled clock profiles
checks.summary: 150 profiles passed at a conditional 4 MHz oscillator / 500 kHz microcycle rate.

checks.title: Worst-case physical timing
checks.summary: CP1 digital evidence is conditional. HCT273 clock delay, HCT245 loading/release and SRAM turnaround lack qualified bounds; the stated 1 MHz envelope is not demonstrated.

checks.title: Clock and driver qualification
checks.summary: Sampled digital duty/frequency corners passed. Startup, loaded edges, reset and full-supply behaviour remain unqualified.

checks.title: Complete timed module integration
checks.summary: Schematic-derived digital integration passed; physical load, clock, reset and SRAM turnaround qualification remain open.

checks.title: Complete timed machine
checks.summary: All opcodes and complete ROM boot passed digitally. Physical programming/readback, supply, clock, reset, routing and external IO remain open.

checks.title: Independent electrical review
checks.summary: Independent review of the selected components and wiring is outstanding.

checks.title: PCB fabrication review
checks.summary: Compact schematics are verified digitally; routed PCB review is outstanding.

checks.title: Hardware calibration
checks.summary: No measured prototype qualification yet.

checks.summary: Eight address-sensitive transfers at the candidate phase separation.

checks.summary: Exact expected monitor sets checked for setup, hold, pulse, reset, contention and wiring faults.

checks.title: Bounded manufacturer-model loaded output (preserved reference evidence)
checks.summary: 50 pF / 1 kohm at 5 V / 25 C: both transitions pass; 65.389 ns minimum margin; nine faults detected.
checks.scope: Bounded analogue experiment for the representative pilot, at the fully specified 5 V / 25 C typical manufacturer-model point. Full operating-envelope/physical qualification remains PILOT-05.
checks.limitation: Nominal bounded experiment only. Full PVT, actual PCB/socket loads, OE handover and physical clock/reset remain PILOT-05 gaps.

provenance.scope: Unchanged verification method or independent software contract; not CP1 physical qualification.

checks.title: Independent microcode ROM audit (preserved reference evidence)
checks.summary: 3,632 opcode/flag sequences; 0 word mismatches; binary 65,536, Logisim 65,536 words.

audit.fill_policy: Unassigned words are zero. This preserves prior internal-gap semantics; invalid opcodes are not fail-stop.

checks.limitation: Independent source expansion and encoding, not timed hardware execution. Zero-fill is a storage policy; unused-opcode behaviour still needs a hardware decision.

provenance.scope: Unchanged verification method or independent software contract; not CP1 physical qualification.

checks.title: Compiled jump/call boundary coverage (preserved reference evidence)
checks.summary: 204,800 target/flag/PC cases; 0 failures; original PC_inc defect detected in both mutation checks.
checks.limitation: JMP/CALL every 16-bit target at operand PC 12FE; all 18 jump/call opcodes at all 256 operand-PC low bytes and 16 flags; flat memory, ideal fetch, extracted Logisim PC updates.

provenance.scope: Unchanged verification method or independent software contract; not CP1 physical qualification.

checks.title: Preserved reference-run failures
checks.summary: The original hardware-programs timeout and dependent boot error remain in the archived report. CP1 is a separate accepted digital design.

checks.title: Verification harness regression tests
checks.summary: 161 tests executed; all passed.

Instrumented hardware meets the operating envelope and repeats the diagnostic tests

risks.title: No guaranteed HCT245 IO capacitance; 10 pF per port is a stated allocation.
HCT245 data/enable timing is taken at 150 pF; disable timing is only guaranteed at 50 pF.
SN74HCT273 SCLS068H switching tables label both delay rows CLR. The 42 ns clock-to-Q simulation value requires manufacturer clarification; it is not accepted as an unambiguous clock-delay guarantee.
SRAM read table uses 30 pF; output release uses 5 pF. Actual DQ load and turnaround require qualification.
HC377 DC compatibility checked at 4.5 V only; full-supply loaded edges remain open.
MCP100-450D does not establish valid 4.75 V startup; the staged system retains an external qualified reset input.
Oscillator startup, duty at receiver thresholds, power integrity, routing and external IO electronics remain open.
Owned 191/245/574 manufacturer/suffix/counts and EPROM programmer/readback remain unresolved.
